integrity: Proof is symbolic; independent external mathematical review has not been performed. Finite tests are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Odd repetition values r>=5, fixed ternary alphabet, single-letter binary coding; no formula at general lengths and no claim for even r. Literature coverage cannot rule out unindexed generalizations.
title: Non-regular abelian complexity for an infinite odd-repetition family of ternary morphisms
